reason: Not another app on my phone, and definitely not one that wants my college Microsoft login. I already get the notices on the class WhatsApp group and the portal, so I'd rather not hand over my account just to see them in a nicer feed.
objection: Signing in with my college account means I have no idea what it can read - my email, my marks, who knows - and the 'marks and email coming later' part makes it worse, not better.
would_change_my_mind: If the university made it the official place where deadlines and exam notices go first, and showed clearly that it only reads announcements and nothing from my email or marks.
